{{Quote|Poor fellow, he's been waiting for his friends to return with my money for a standard month now.|Eli Gand to Revan, regarding Matton Dasol and his crew|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
'''Matton Dasol's crew ''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crew that worked with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Matton Dasol]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] often and acquired a large [[Currency/Legends|debt]] to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Eli Gand]]. In [[3956 BBY]], Dasol was forced to be an indentured [[Slavery/Legends|servant]] while they paid back the debt, but Gand tricked, ambushed, and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the crew in Kashyyyk's [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], attempting to retain Dasol's servitude indefinitely. The fate of the crew was recorded by their [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]] and eventually discovered by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Revan confronted Gand, who ran off, leaving Dasol to take control of the merchant's business.

==Description==
[[File:RuinedRube-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Matton Dasol was a mechanic for the crew.]]
The crew consisted of several [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including [[D-A02]], the ship's [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]], which was equipped with an [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensor]]. It also included at least three [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] mechanic [[Matton Dasol]]. The crew owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which was occasionally in need of repairs.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==History==
===In debt===
{{Quote|Do you always enslave your debtors''"<br />"''Enslave? I resent that. Simply fair business. This man's fellows left without settling their debts, so he must make up the difference.|Revan and Eli Matton discussing Matton Dasol|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Matton Dasol and the rest of the crew were known to have stopped frequently on the [[Forest/Legends|forested]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|kashyyyk|Kashyyyk}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. During their visits to the planet, known at the [[Time/Legends|time]] by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] as Edean, they incurred a large [[Currency/Legends|debt]] to [[Eli Gand]], a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who charged high interest on loans.<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> Gand forced Dasol into indentured [[Slavery/Legends|servitude]] while his crew paid back the debt.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===Ambushed===
{{Quote|I don't get it. That merchant said there was salvage down here. We need Matton to work the sensors.''"<br />"''When he gets back we'll&hellip; wait&hellip; I'm getting something. Oh it's Eli. Good. Maybe he'll point us in the right direction.|Two members of Dasol's crew right before Gand's ambush|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
[[File:D-A02.png|thumb|right|250px|The remains of D-A02]]
Dasol's crew was able to raise and give Gand the money, but he was not released immediately. Instead, he was absent for two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] working on Gand's ship in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. During Dasol's absence, Gand tricked and lured the crew into Kashyyyk's [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], telling them that they could find salvage. The group was unable to find anything, but detected Gand on the sensors. They believed he could point them in the right direction, but Gand instead ambushed and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the crew with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], attempting to keep Dasol in service as a mechanic permanently.

The crew's repair droid, D-A02, recorded the last moments of the crew before being destroyed itself by Gand. Though the droid's primary [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]] failed, the droid remained recognizable and carried the audio recording in it's barely functional [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]]. Gand lied to Dasol, telling him that his crew left the planet without paying the repair bill. Seemingly abandoned by his friends, Dasol remained as a servant to Gand until they returned, under the guise of standard trading rules.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===The truth===
Thirty-six days later, former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who [[Amnesia/Legends|lost]] his memories and [[Jedi training/Legends|retrained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], arrived on Kashyyyk during his search for the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Map]]s. He spoke to Dasol and Gand and learned of the former's servitude.<ref name="KOTOR" />

During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the planet, Revan entered the Shadowlands.<ref name="KOTOR" /> While exploring, he discovered D-A02's remains.<ref name="CSWE D-A02">{{CSWECite|I|159|D-A02}}</ref> The droid played back the audio recording before shutting down, and Revan thus learned of Gand's deception. Revan put the droid's head in his pack, causing the rest of the droid's remains to experience a power surge and explode. Returning back to the heights of the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]], he confronted Gand. Revan showed the men the droid's head, and though Gand tried to dismiss it as simple garbage, Dasol recognized the droid and realized what transpired, calling Gand a [[Snake/Legends|snake]]. Revan convinced Dasol to not resort to violence, and Gand ran off to the Shadowlands. Dasol,<ref name="KOTOR" /> now freed from his servitude,<ref name="CSWE Eli">{{CSWECite|I|319|Gand, Eli}}</ref> but without a ship, decided to stay and run Gand's store, though he expected to face some difficulties with Gand's former clients. He wished to pay for passage off Kashyyyk, rather than get involved with more debt. To reward Revan, Dasol gave him [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], though he noted he could always spend them at his newly acquired shop.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The recording of the crew's final moments was later used against Gand in a trial.<ref name="CSWE D-A02" />

==Behind the scenes==
Matton Dasol's crew appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The crew is involved in the "Honest Debt" quest, which is optional and requires the player to speak to Gand and Dasol. If the player does not complete the quest before inciting the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to revolt against the Czerka Corporation,<ref name="KOTOR" /> as is the path confirmed by ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE Chuundar">{{CSWECite|I|127|Chuundar}}</ref> the quest will be completed automatically and the men are forced off the planet.<ref name="KOTOR" /> Entries in ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' for D-A02,<ref name="CSWE D-A02" /> Gand<ref name="CSWE Eli" /> and Dasol confirm that Revan recovered D-A02's remains and confronted Gand,<ref name="CSWE Matton">{{CSWECite|I|172|Dasol, Matton}}</ref> so Revan must have done so before confronting and deposing [[Chuundar]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
